cases.name: etaf-xiangqi-help-survives-the-computer-reply
cases.purpose: Computer search and paced move presentation continue under help without stealing focus or replacing its opening snapshot; undo remains usable after closing.

cases.name: etaf-xiangqi-slow-search-does-not-add-a-second-delay
cases.purpose: A search longer than the response interval is not followed by a second artificial delay.

cases.name: etaf-xiangqi-fast-reply-waits-and-keeps-visible-move-markers
cases.purpose: A fast computer reply waits for the reading interval, then exposes persistent endpoints and a caption across both themes.

cases.name: etaf-xiangqi-reset-and-close-discard-delayed-replies
cases.purpose: Reset and close supersede a delayed reply without ghost moves or callbacks into a disposed match.

cases.name: etaf-xiangqi-winning-reply-keeps-its-caption
cases.purpose: A winning computer move names the winner and retains its final move caption.

cases.name: etaf-xiangqi-capture-description-with-reduced-motion
cases.purpose: The reduced-motion and terminal path still names a captured piece after the reading interval.

cases.name: etaf-xiangqi-computer-rejection-stops-and-new-match-recovers
cases.purpose: A rejected computer move stays visible without retrying; New match recovers and lets the computer open.

cases.name: etaf-xiangqi-computer-opening-move-arrives-first
cases.purpose: With the computer on red, its opening move needs no local input and leaves the human to move.

cases.name: etaf-xiangqi-computer-replies-with-a-search-move
cases.purpose: The computer answers a human move with the default search budget and keeps the human's perspective.

cases.name: etaf-xiangqi-computer-undo-restores-the-human-turn
cases.purpose: One undo takes back the computer's reply and the human's own move.

cases.name: etaf-xiangqi-dialog-and-escape-dismiss-one-layer
cases.purpose: All help entries share an in-buffer searchable modal, preserve the selected stone and native match, and dismiss one Escape layer at a time.

cases.name: etaf-xiangqi-hot-seat-moves-and-undo-restores
cases.purpose: Red and black alternate through the public board and undo restores the opening.

cases.name: etaf-xiangqi-check-is-announced-and-explains-an-immobile-stone
cases.purpose: A non-terminal check names itself in the status line, a stone that cannot answer it explains why, and an interposing move still resolves it.

cases.name: etaf-xiangqi-invalid-action-preserves-the-board
cases.purpose: An action outside the legal set changes nothing and is reported.

cases.name: etaf-xiangqi-settings-level-drives-the-search
cases.purpose: The difficulty picker selects the search budget the backend uses for the next move.

cases.name: etaf-xiangqi-settings-switch-to-hot-seat
cases.purpose: The settings dialog hands both sides to the local player without a computer reply.

cases.name: etaf-xiangqi-themes-preserve-the-match
cases.purpose: Switching the light and dark palettes preserves the match, selection and board metrics.

cases.name: etaf-xiangqi-matches-are-independent
cases.purpose: One running match cannot change a second match.

cases.name: etaf-xiangqi-hosted-session-renders-in-its-host
cases.purpose: A session created for a host mounts no presentation of its own, and the single host that renders it receives the computer's reply repaint.
